base_paper: Hazarika et al., IEEE Trans. ICPS, 2025
our_novelty: First multiclass (10-class) extension of IALSTM for smart IP cameras. Applied Focal Loss to handle class imbalance in TON_IoT. Extended from binary (Normal/Attack) to 9 attack type classification.
